description: Dataset-record schema for the Phase 2C candidate-conditioned training pipeline. Distinct from (references) src/ai/ranker/schema.json, which defines only the per-candidate feature encoding. See docs/repair/showboat-ml/phase-2c/DATASET_DESIGN.md.

fields.dataset_schema_version: string, must equal this file's dataset_schema_version
fields.feature_schema_version: string, must equal src/ai/ranker/schema.json's schema_version at generation time
fields.example_id: string — sha256(family_id, state_id, candidate_id), stable across regeneration with the same seed
fields.split: enum: train | val | test — assigned by family_id, never state_id or example_id
fields.candidate_id: integer — index into generateCandidates()'s output for this state
fields.candidate_kind: enum: direct | bank | double-bank | combo | rail-combo
fields.candidate_target: integer ball id — Candidate.target (first legal contact)
fields.candidate_pot_id: integer ball id — Candidate.potId (ball meant to actually drop)
fields.features: number[68] — encodeRow() output, pre-shot only (validated: no post-shot-derived value)
fields.nominal_action: { phi, power, sideSpin, topSpin } — Candidate.action before perturbation
fields.perturbation_seed_base: integer, derived deterministically from master seed + example_id

raw_counts.any_pot: int — candidate_pot_id present in sim.pocketed, regardless of legality
raw_counts.own_balls_pocketed_total: int, summed across the n_perturbations trials
raw_counts.terminal_win: int — trials where this shot ends the game as a win for the shooter
raw_counts.terminal_loss: int — trials where this shot ends the game as a loss for the shooter

fields.generator_version: string — git commit generating this row
fields.candidate_generator_version: string — git commit of candidates.ts (same commit in practice; recorded separately for future drift detection)
fields.rules_version: string — git commit of rules.ts (same commit in practice; recorded separately)

invariants: no golden-origin family_id is ever assigned a split
every state_id belongs to exactly one family_id
every family_id is assigned to exactly one split
